shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every day.
My favorite food is pizza with extra cheese.
I often go for a run in the park.
Traveling to new places is always exciting to me.
I love listening to music while I work or study.
Cooking at home can be a fun and rewarding experience.
Spending time with friends boosts my happiness and mood.
I like to explore different cultures through their food and traditions.
Hiking in the mountains gives me a sense of peace and adventure.
Volunteering in my community has taught me the value of helping others.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share your favorite travel experience?
Q2: What challenges do you usually face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important do you think travel is for personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study methods.
questions: Q1: What study techniques have worked best for you in school?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties while studying for exams?
Q3: In your opinion, what is the most effective way to learn new information?
Q4: What tips would you offer to students who struggle with studying?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about family traditions.
questions: Q1: What is a special tradition your family has?
Q2: How do these traditions impact your family life?
Q3: Why do you think family traditions are important?
Q4: What new tradition would you like to start in your family?
